0022600101.text: The Grizzlies visit the Golden State Warriors for Memphis's second game of the 2026-27 season, and neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (ankle), while Golden State is without Brandin Podziemski (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). In the 2025-26 season series, the Grizzlies lost 0-3, most recently 133-112 in Memphis on February 25, 2026.
